page.overview:
Who is Blindfold Guy?

Blindfold Guy makes his only appearance in "Five Short Graybles." He operates the lever on the Catapult that Finn uses to do the "super ultimate high-five." After pulling the lever, he fell off the catapult and lay motionless on the ground.

He appears to be a brown humanoid wearing a teal scarf that completely covers his head. Relative to Finn, he is very small.
